WITH matched AS (
  SELECT c.transref, tr.tradekind, c.prevviol
  FROM compliancecase AS c
  JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = c.transref
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = r.trdref
),
group_avgs AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(prevviol) AS avg_prevviol
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_prevviol) AS overall_avg_prevviol
  FROM group_avgs
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT g.transref, g.tradekind, g.avg_prevviol,
         g.avg_prevviol / o.overall_avg_prevviol AS ratio
  FROM group_avgs AS g
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
  WHERE o.overall_avg_prevviol IS NOT NULL
),
type_avgs AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM ratios
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
  SELECT r.avg_prevviol, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference
  FROM ratios AS r
  JOIN type_avgs AS a ON CAST(r.tradekind AS TEXT) = CAST(a.tradekind AS TEXT)
  WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_prevviol) AS average_group_previous_violations,
       AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(difference) AS average_difference
FROM kept
